description.p: Moira displays Claude five-hour and weekly usage plus Codex weekly usage, reset times, optional native and NTFY notifications, and a History tab with selectable ranges, exact Codex token statistics, and CSV/JSON export.

Adds the History tab with selectable 24h/7d/30d/90d ranges and per-service filters, quota series with reset transitions, availability states, and exact daily token statistics computed from official Codex account usage (Claude remains percentage-only).

Adds per-provider collection toggles and alert rules, native desktop and NTFY notification channels with deduplicated exhaustion, recovery, reset and error events, compact mode, sanitized diagnostics with copy actions, deterministic CSV/JSON export, history deletion, and manual update checks.

Corrects post-reset recovery detection with a pure recovery-transition rule that distinguishes prior weekly exhaustion evidence from current non-exhausted state, enabling recovery events for real post-reset chronology.

Preserves all valid refresh intervals during v1-to-v2 migration, unifies exhaustion semantics between UI and notifications with reset-aware canonical rule, suppresses only the duplicate generic 100% threshold alert, and corrects a French localization typo.

Weekly exhaustion semantics, French localization with English fallback, visible configurable refresh interval, focus-regain refresh, 30-second countdown recompute, and deduplicated exhaustion/recovery NTFY events.
